newsitem.title: USA: Loewen files to issue up to 5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Loewen files to issue up to 5 mln shares.

text.p: In shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Thursday, Loewen Group Inc said it would issue up to five million common shares, while certain shareholders would sell up to 1,216,011 shares.
The stock offer by the company is in connection with the acquitision by the company of funeral home, cemetery and related businesses or properties, the filing said.

The stock may be issued in mergers or consolidations, in exchange for shares of capital stock, partnership interests or other assets representing an interest in other companies or other entities, the filing said.
The selling shareholders include: Provident Indemnity Life Insurance Co, offering 558,519 INTERRUPTED
